subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw adopt account-scoped channel reload targets for `channels.<channel>.accounts.<accountId>.*` changes, using whole-channel restart only for global/default/unlisted/secrets cases?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but changing gateway reload granularity is compatibility- and availability-sensitive across all channel plugins and needs maintainer ownership before the open implementation PR lands.

options.title: Review and land PR 99312
options.body: Accept the generic gateway plan/executor change after maintainer review of the account fallback and delivery-risk cases.

options.title: Keep whole-channel restarts
options.body: Reject the granularity change and document that account-scoped edits intentionally restart the whole channel.

options.title: Narrow to one channel first
options.body: Ask for a Telegram- or Mattermost-only mitigation if maintainers do not want a generic gateway reload contract yet.

recommendation.title: Review and land PR 99312
recommendation.body: Accept the generic gateway plan/executor change after maintainer review of the account fallback and delivery-risk cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway reload-plan work and current-main authorship make this the best available routing candidate from the local and GitHub history.
